reason: I would take the 60-day trial because I keep my old POS and terminal, so nothing risky happens on a Saturday. The free fee check and a Vietnamese person standing at my desk is what makes me try it, and I can call another owner first.
objection: What happens when the internet goes down on a busy Saturday? If tickets stop or I lose money, my techs will blame me, not you.
would_change_my_mind: I call a salon owner who has run it through a bad internet day and they tell me tickets and tips kept saving and nothing was lost.
